##### Project general facts

OceaniQ 2 is a premium mixed-use resort development by OceaniQ, an award-winning Bali-based developer that has earned a strong international reputation since its founding and been recognised as a two-time winner at the Asia Pacific Property Awards. The project is trusted by professional investment funds and family offices from the USA, Canada, and Europe, with due diligence conducted by international firm SSEK, ensuring the highest standards of legal and investment security. OceaniQ 2 presents a thoughtfully curated collection of apartments, villas, and penthouses, all designed by the acclaimed SL Architects bureau — an internationally celebrated practice with over four hundred completed projects across the globe, including award-winning work in Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Together, OceaniQ's construction expertise and SL Architects' design mastery create a development of exceptional quality, character, and investment credibility.

OceaniQ 2 delivers a world-class lifestyle infrastructure that rivals the finest resort properties on the island. The centrepiece wellness offering is The Eywa Spa — a vast, immersive spa sanctuary encompassing extensive treatment, relaxation, and sensory spaces designed to nurture the body and mind at the deepest level. Complementing this is a dedicated fitness, workout, and yoga space, a gourmet restaurant, a café-coworking concept, kids' areas, a fruit garden, a river valley setting, and a grand lobby. Concierge service, laundry, reception, and transfer services ensure that every aspect of daily life is handled with seamless, resort-standard care. The breadth and quality of the amenity offering positions OceaniQ 2 as a truly self-contained premium lifestyle destination.

The architecture and interiors of OceaniQ 2 reflect a philosophy of engineering excellence guided by global standards and a deep respect for the natural environment. Panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows frame breathtaking views of the ocean and tropical gardens, while spacious living rooms and bedrooms bathed in natural light through high ceilings create an atmosphere of effortless openness and calm. Premium natural materials are used throughout, with elegant detailing — including striking floating staircases and refined door heights — that elevate every interior to a level of quiet, confident sophistication. Construction quality is underpinned by a comprehensive triple waterproofing system, climate-experienced architects, and full structural warranties, ensuring that every residence looks and feels as exceptional in years to come as it does on arrival.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nusa Dua is widely regarded as Bali's most prestigious and carefully managed tourism enclave, a gated coastal zone purpose-built to the highest international standards and maintained with a level of cleanliness, security, and order that is unmatched anywhere else on the island. The setting is graced with some of Bali's rare sandy beaches offering gentle, swimmable entry and calm waters — a quality that draws discerning visitors from across the world and makes the area genuinely special among Bali's many coastal destinations. Wide, pedestrian-friendly streets, manicured landscaping, round-the-clock security, and minimal traffic create an atmosphere of private resort living that feels entirely removed from the bustle of the broader island. It is an enclave where beauty, safety, and exclusivity coexist in a way that no other part of Bali can quite replicate.

The surrounding area offers an extraordinary concentration of world-class amenities and leisure destinations within effortless reach. Bali Collection — the island's largest open-air shopping and entertainment complex — sits a short stroll away, housing boutiques, international restaurants, cinemas, spas, and art galleries within a beautifully landscaped setting. The Bali National Golf Club, considered one of Asia's premier championship courses, is reachable within minutes, while an exceptional selection of gourmet dining venues — including oceanfront restaurants, celebrated Italian dining, and vibrant café culture — lines the neighbourhood. Neighbouring properties include The St. Regis, Grand Hyatt, The Mulia, Conrad, and Marriott, placing OceaniQ 2 in the company of the world's most recognised luxury hospitality brands and confirming the area's standing as a destination of the highest calibre.

Nusa Dua presents one of the most compelling and enduring investment propositions in all of Southeast Asian real estate, driven by a combination of factors that are increasingly rare and irreplaceable. The coastline is effectively fully built out — no more first-line beachfront land is available — creating a natural scarcity that underpins long-term capital value and ensures that well-positioned assets here will only appreciate in desirability over time. Premium tourism flow is structurally guaranteed by the presence of flagship international hotel brands, a captive high-spending visitor base, and the area's outstanding reputation for safety and quality. For investors and lifestyle buyers alike, this location represents an opportunity to own a piece of Bali's finest and most finite address.
